about_the_game:
You wake up in an abandoned place.

killer is out for your life.

　

“#from #abandoned” is a survival action horror game where players must escape a killer-infested abandoned facility using traps and gimmicks strategically.

You’ll control a group of randomly selected characters as you try to survive.

The killers won’t show mercy—they hunt you relentlessly.

Running won’t be enough. Outsmart them with clever traps, work together with your allies, and find a way to survive.

This is a twisted “death game show” orchestrated by a mysterious figure known only as the Game Master.

Can you escape this madness?

Features

A team of randomly selected playable characters

Each character has unique traits and starts with different items

Each killer has distinct behavior and hunting patterns

Strategic survival action where setting traps before the killers is key

Highly replayable escape gameplay with different outcomes

A sinister set of rules and narrative controlled by the unseen Game Master

Recommended for:

Players who enjoy both horror and strategy

Fans of unpredictable scenarios and multiple survival routes

Those who love mind games with killers and making the most of traps

One decision can mean the difference between life and death.

Will you survive the Game Master’s deadly play?
